## About
Hillside Auto Repair is an owner-operated shop on Hawthorne Blvd in Torrance. We work on American, Asian and European cars, gas or hybrid, plus RVs, motorhomes and minibuses.
Before you approve anything, we show you what we found with testing, digital inspection photos and a written quote. Aatif and Alex come up by name in our reviews, and Javier, our Euro master tech, looks after the European makes.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 363 reviews. Stop by during the week or on Saturday mornings, or book online.

## Services
- Brake pads, rotors and calipers: Brake checks with photos, plus pads, rotors, calipers and brake fluid.
- Check engine and diagnostics: Steady or flashing light, we test to find the real cause instead of swapping parts.
- Oil change and inspection: The oil your engine specifies, with a full digital inspection every visit.
- Tire sales and installation: New tires with mounting and balancing included.
- Hybrid service and repair: Hybrid maintenance and repair. One reviewer had us replace their hybrid batteries.
- Auto electrical repair: Batteries, starters, alternators and wiring, including slow cranks and batteries that keep dying.
- Tune-ups and scheduled maintenance: Spark plugs, ignition, filters and the factory maintenance schedule your manufacturer designed.
- Digital vehicle inspection: Handy when you're buying a used car: on-lift checks, a scan where the car allows, and a photo-backed report you can keep and share.
- Commercial accounts: Work vehicles kept moving, with local pickup and no minimum fleet size.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my extended warranty?
A: Yes. We work with all of them, dealer or third-party.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes, Saturdays from 9am to 3pm. We're closed Sundays.

Q: Do you offer a shuttle?
A: Yes, there's a free shuttle within 5 miles of the shop.
